reflexion_1.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
dc_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.0369, 38.9072])
dc_buffer = dc_point.buffer(10000)  # 10km buffer around DC center
start_date = '2018-01-01'
end_date = '2018-12-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition - GPM Precipitation
gpm = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(dc_buffer) \
    .select('precipitation')

# Check if collection has data
collection_size = gpm.size().getInfo()
print(f"GPM Images in 2018: {collection_size}")

if collection_size == 0:
    print("No precipitation data found for Washington D.C. in 2018.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Calculate total precipitation
    # GPM precipitation is in mm/hr, measured every 30 minutes
    # Sum all precipitation values and multiply by 0.5 (30min = 0.5hr)
    total_precip_mm = gpm.select('precipitation').sum().multiply(0.5)
    
    # 4. Get statistics
    stats = total_precip_mm.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=dc_buffer,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    precip_mm = stats.get('precipitation').getInfo()
    
    # Also check pixel count
    count_stats = total_precip_mm.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=dc_buffer,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    pixel_count = count_stats.get('precipitation').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Valid pixels: {pixel_count}")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if pixel_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif precip_mm is None:
        print("Calculation returned None.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        precip_inches = precip_mm / 25.4  # Convert mm to inches
        print(f"Total precipitation in 2018: {precip_mm:.2f} mm ({precip_inches:.2f} inches)")
        print(f"Threshold: 50 inches (1270 mm)")
        
        if precip_inches >= 50:
            print("Washington D.C. experienced at least 50 inches of rainfall in 2018.")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("Washington D.C. did not experience 50 inches of rainfall in 2018.")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
